notes.title: 🎮Noctuary Lite Version is Live! Now Officially Compatible with SteamDeck!
notes.content: [p]Dear players, [/p][p]Great news! To meet the needs of more players and improve the gameplay experience, we are officially releasing the [i][b]Noctuary[/b][/i][b] Lite Version DLC[/b]! It is mainly focused on performance optimization.[/p][p][b]✨ Features of the Lite Version:[/b] [/p][p]✅ [b]Rebuilt resource loading system:[/b] By increasing disk space usage, runtime memory (RAM) consumption has been reduced. This change mainly addresses stuttering and crashes on lower-performance devices. Please note that the required storage space will increase after the update. [/p][p]✅ [b]Adjusted asset precision:[/b] Certain art assets have been compressed to lower GPU load, power consumption, and device overheating. This may slightly impact visual quality. [/p][p]✅ [b]Added platform compatibility:[/b] [i]SteamDeck[/i] players are recommended to use the Lite version.[/p][p]✨ [b]This optimization is primarily intended for devices with the following specifications (or similar performance):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 [/p][/*][*][p]Memory: 8GB RAM [/p][/*][*][p]Disk space: 11GB [/p][/*][*][p]Graphics card: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030[/p][/*][/list][p][b]✨ How to Launch:[/b][/p][p]After downloading the Lite Version DLC, please click Steam Library--Home--Find "Noctuary"--Right click--Properties--DLC--Check, click [b]Play Now[/b]. It will replace the base game and launch in Lite Version mode.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/c18c30132555f4fc9323d1ec5aedeefbc858bcdc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956933/7e74ea571c58ceb0c170f5180f65e1067a92e5e0.png"][/img][/p][p]If you want to play the base game version. Please click Steam Library--Home--Find "Noctuary"--Right click--Properties--DLC--Uncheck.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary:[/b] [/p][p]This update is intended to provide smoother gameplay options for devices with specifications close to those listed above, at the cost of larger installation size and some compromise in visual quality.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and support！[/p][p][/p][p]Gratesca Studio[/p][p]2nd September, 2025[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you are enjoying your time in Inlixaland, if you encounter any issues during the game, or if you’d like to share your ideas for upcoming updates, here are some useful links:[/p][p]Gratesca Official Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/pT4nK8hN34"]https://discord.gg/pT4nK8hN34[/url][/p][p]Steam Discussion Thread: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2143680/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2143680/discussions/[/url][/p][p]BUG report E-mail: [url="https://gratesca_promote@126.com"]gratesca_promote@126.com[/url][/p][p]Twitter: [url="https://x.com/Gratesca_Studio"]@Gratesca Studio[/url][/p][p]Youtube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/@gratescastudio9046"]@Gratesca Studio[/url][/p]

notes.title: Noctuary Trading Cards & Points Shop Items Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Illuminators,

The exclusive Trading Cards & Points Shop Items for Noctuary will officially launch, accompanied by a historic low-price sale!
Come claim your community items and decorate your profile now!

This set of Noctuary exclusive community items includes:
[b] 1[/b] Badge set, [b]9[/b] Trading Cards, [b]4[/b] Profile Backgrounds, and [b]8[/b] Emoticons!

- **Trading Cards**:  You can play a participating game to get trading cards. Half the card set is received during gameplay (based on playtime in the game), the other half is earned through collecting (trading with or buying from other users through Steam and the Steam Community Market).
- **Crafting Badges**: A full set of cards can be crafted into a game badge that can be prominently displayed on the profile and the mini profile (seen when hovering on a user's avatar.)
- **Get Rewards**: During badge crafting users receive random rewards from a set of game related items including emoticons, profile backgrounds, and coupons.

What are you waiting for? Head to Inlixaland and claim your exclusive Illuminators cards now!

notes.title: 《Noctuary》 Release Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are excited to announce that our latest entertainment creation, "Noctuary," is now available on the Steam platform. The original price for the is $29.99, but for the first week, it's on sale at 20% off. We welcome you to make a purchase and embark on this enchanting journey.

"Noctuary" is a single-player game primarily centered around visual novel adventures, with an isometric view and clear level design as secondary elements. The gameplay lasts approximately 30 hours. In the realm of visual novel adventures, "Noctuary" focuses on a lengthy storyline, offering multiple branching endings. It features text in multiple languages and bilingual voiceovers. In terms of level design, it incorporates fundamental elements of popular action games, along with a few developmental features and a "Blessing Petal" system that allows for flexible strategic combinations. Additionally, the game supports keyboard and mouse, controllers, and gameplay on the Steam Deck.

The game provides options for Action Mode, Story Mode, and Custom Mode, allowing players to switch between them at any time. Action Mode offers a certain level of challenge and is suitable for action game enthusiasts. Story Mode and Custom Mode, on the other hand, are designed for players who prefer to focus on the narrative or customize various features, enhancing the performance of controllable characters.

Regarding the user experience, "Noctuary" acknowledges some shortcomings, such as suboptimal logic in side-quest releases, high difficulty in combat initiation, and the inability to fast-forward certain cutscenes. Despite these challenges, we are committed to improving the overall gaming experience and achieving a sense of "comprehensive balance."

The information provided above outlines the basic features of the product. We sincerely ask for your understanding of any shortcomings. We earnestly request players to carefully consider whether "Noctuary" qualifies as a worthy addition to their gaming library. If so, we hope you make a purchase; if not, until we meet again.

Thank you all for your support!

Gratesca Studio
Tuesday 28th November, 2023
